raw.query: SELECT img.max/img.mean as img_peak_to_mean, req.max/req.mean as req_peak_to_mean, img.cv2/req.cv2 as burstiness_ratio FROM (SELECT value_num as max FROM provenance.eda_metric WHERE metric_path='window_1min.img_per_s.max') img, (SELECT value_num as mean FROM provenance.eda_metric WHERE metric_path='window_1min.img_per_s.mean') imgm, (SELECT value_num as max FROM provenance.eda_metric WHERE metric_path='window_1min.req_per_s.max') req, (SELECT value_num as mean FROM provenance.eda_metric WHERE metric_path='window_1min.req_per_s.mean') reqm, (SELECT value_num as cv2 FROM provenance.eda_metric WHERE metric_path='window_1min.img_per_s.cv2') imgcv, (SELECT value_num as cv2 FROM provenance.eda_metric WHERE metric_path='window_1min.req_per_s.cv2') reqcv
